name: Bri'ahl
description: The Bri'ahls were humanoids indigenous to the forested planet of Bri'ahl. They had pink skin, large eyes that lacked colored irises, squarish noses, large sharp teeth, funnel-shaped ears, and three fingers and a thumb on each hand.

data.name: Bri'ahl
data.distinctions: Large eyes, squarish noses, sharp teeth
